visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor parkour gym environment with black and yellow industrial decor. A young boy in a white t-shirt and blue patterned shorts runs and climbs over obstacles. A man with long dark hair and glasses (Peter) follows him closely, observing his movements. (2) Inside a bright, white living space, the boy stands in front of a black leather sofa, smiling and playfully throwing a punch toward the camera. (3) The family, including Peter, Susan, and two children, is seen walking through a modern hallway toward the entrance of the parkour school 'ADD Taiwan'. (4) A sequence showing various children practicing parkour in the gym; the boy performs a roll on a padded mat while other children are visible in the background. (5) Susan is seated on a black couch in a well-lit indoor area, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. A banner for 'F45 Training' is visible behind her. (6) Visual inserts of medical-related text overlays appear over scenes of the boy jumping, listing symptoms and risks of meningitis. (7) Susan holds up several copies of the 'Child Health Handbook' (yellow booklets) to the camera while sitting in the same indoor area. (8) A group shot of Peter, Susan, and their two children sitting together on a couch, looking happy and healthy.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 又是萌新的一天. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們今天來挑戰一個超酷的活動. (3) [Subtitle]: 小小忍者跑酷課. (4) [Subtitle]: 對 因為家裡這兩隻精力太旺盛了. (5) [Subtitle]: 帶來這裡不旦可以好好放電. (6) [Subtitle]: 還能訓練他們的肢體協調 & 專注力. (7) [Subtitle]: 但這個畫面雖然只是課程的一部分卻讓我想起. (8) [Subtitle]: 孩子健康跑跳、學習這一切都不是理所當然的. (9) [Subtitle]: 這也讓我們更去正視一些平時容易忽略. (10) [Subtitle]: 但後果卻非常嚴重的疾病. (11) [Subtitle]: 像是 腦膜炎. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們去瞭解之後發現腦膜炎之所以棘手有三難特性. (13) [Subtitle]: 第一是難以診斷. (14) [Variety]: 發燒. [Variety]: 頭痛. [Variety]: 嘔吐. (15) [Subtitle]: 真的跟流感很像很容易讓人輕忽. (16) [Subtitle]: 但它的病程發展卻非常快. (17) [Subtitle]: 可能在短短24小時內就變得非常危險. (18) [Subtitle]: 第二難以防備. (19) [Subtitle]: 因為細菌會透過飛沫在群體中傳播. (20) [Subtitle]: 而有些帶菌者自己是沒有症狀的. (21) [Subtitle]: 像這種群聚環境無形中就增加了接觸的風險. (22) [Subtitle]: 最可怕的是第三點 難以挽回. (23) [Subtitle]: 就算及時治療存活下來的孩子中還是有將近兩成. (24) [Subtitle]: 可能要面對永久性的後遺症. (25) [Variety]: 截肢. [Variety]: 聽力損傷. [Variety]: 智力受損等. (26) [Subtitle]: 每一次的跳躍都需要健康的雙腳與良好的平衡感. (27) [Subtitle]: 每一次的指導都需要清晰的聽力去理解. (28) [Subtitle]: 而每一次的挑戰都需要專注的思考與學習能力. (29) [Subtitle]: 這些腦膜炎後遺症可能剝奪的能力恰好就是他們此刻. (30) [Subtitle]: 正在發光發熱的寶藏. (31) [Subtitle]: 所以光是擔心沒有用主動預防才是真正的關鍵. (32) [Subtitle]: 我們要從基本的勤洗手還有在人多的密閉場所裡面戴口罩. (33) [Subtitle]: 這也是保護自己也是保護其他人的第一步喔. (34) [Subtitle]: 沒錯而且要跟醫生好好溝通. (35) [Subtitle]: 對 主動諮詢. (36) [Subtitle]: 打開孩子們的兒童健康手冊. (37) [Subtitle]: 去瞭解包含疫苗在內的所有預防方式. (38) [Subtitle]: 才能夠為他們做出最周全的決定. (39) [Subtitle]: 守護好他們的健康就是守護他們奔向未來的每一步.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Peter (man with long dark hair, light blue sleeveless hoodie), Susan (woman with hair up, black and white Adidas jersey), and their two young children (boy in white t-shirt/blue shorts and a toddler girl).

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a modern industrial-style parkour gym (ADD Taiwan) with black equipment and yellow accents, a minimalist white living room, and a seating area in a gym lobby with branded backdrops.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Starts with upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a steady rhythmic beat. A male voice (Peter) narrates with a friendly, high-energy tone. Background noise of an indoor gym is audible but faint. (2) A sharp transition as a female voice (Susan) enters, maintaining the warm and conversational tone. A soft percussive 'thud' SFX occurs as a child lands on a mat. (3) The BGM transitions to a more serious, minor-key piano melody. Susan's voice becomes more authoritative and somber as she explains the risks of meningitis. Short digital 'pop' sound effects highlight key symptoms mentioned. (4) The BGM shifts back to a more hopeful, steady acoustic pattern. Peter and Susan's voices overlap slightly as they discuss hygiene and prevention. (5) Closing with Susan's clear, instructional tone. A child's voice is briefly heard saying '好玩' (fun). The music fades out gently with a final piano chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Narrative Experience -> Educational Transition -> Actionable Steps -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a public health awareness message disguised as a family vlog. It uses the visual of active, healthy children participating in parkour to emphasize how precious their mobility is, then transitions to educating parents about the risks, symptoms, and long-term consequences of meningitis. It concludes by urging parents to check health handbooks and consult doctors about vaccination.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names a disease (Meningitis), lists symptoms, and shows Susan holding up 'Child Health Handbooks' while advising parents to consult doctors about vaccines.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective blend of personal storytelling and educational content designed for social media parenting circles.
